invariants.rationale: The returned Array<AssetDescriptor> is constructed and returned; it is never null in the provided code.
Array.size in libGDX cannot be negative; this is always true.
The method directly passes tmxFile to xml.parse, so it cannot be null without throwing a NullPointerException.
fileName is used in string concatenation in the exception and so must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException in the catch block.
